newsitem.title: UK: Deferred Brent kept by equity holder Shell - trade.
newsitem.headline: Deferred Brent kept by equity holder Shell - trade.

text.p: The sole Brent date nominated loading dates on Tuesday was kept by equity holder Shell, traders said.
The cargo was due to load June 25-27 after being deferred from its original slot of June 14-16, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
